sample_unit: records from public datasets (Pima Indian Diabetes, Frankfurt Hospital Diabetes, heart disease)

links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy versus best traditional ML/DL models on disease prediction
links.effect: ChatGPT did not outperform traditional machine learning and deep learning models; GPT-4o 5-shot reached 77.07% (Pima diabetes), 75.85% (Frankfurt diabetes), 83.65% (heart disease).
links.quote: Even though ChatGPT does not outperform traditional machine learning and deep learning models, these findings highlight its potential as a complementary tool in disease prediction.

unlisted_practices: prompt engineering (few-shot, chain-of-thought, knowledge-enhanced CoT) for LLM disease prediction
clarifying column names and categorical values in prompts

screen.reason: Evaluates prompting strategies (zero-shot, few-shot, CoT) for ChatGPT on standard chronic disease prediction tabular benchmark datasets (e.g., Pima Indian Diabetes Dataset).
